description: DAG for PlanExe, an AI-driven project planning system.

nodes.description: Generate aggressive, moderate, and conservative scenarios from the vital few levers.
Guardrail: verify generated scenarios respect the user's constraints.
Identify a primary domain and zero or more secondary domains for the project.
Merge locations, currency, risks, and assumption stages into one reference document.
Consolidate all governance phases into a single markdown document.
Convert the raw pitch JSON into a polished, scannable markdown document.
Create a compelling project pitch with target audience, call to action, and risk mitigation.
Build the project schedule and generate Gantt charts.
Extract the project title and top-level phases (WBS Level 1) from the project plan.
Decompose top-level phases into major tasks (WBS Level 2).
Break Level 2 tasks into detailed subtasks (WBS Level 3).
Choose the project currency based on physical locations and cross-border needs.
Specify data-gathering actions needed to validate the plan: market, financial, regulatory, etc.
Condense verbose assumptions into concise, strategically important ones.
Draft content specs for each document to create: essential info, risks, and scenarios.
Draft content specs for each document to find: essential info, risks, and scenarios.
Add description, synergy, and conflict text to each lever.
Develop background story for each team member.
Determine contract type for each team member.
Add equipment needs and facility requirements for each team member's role.
Guardrail: verify enriched levers still respect the user's constraints.
Estimate realistic, minimum, and maximum durations for each WBS task bottom-up.
Produce a concise one-pager for decision-makers with key findings and recommendations.
Assemble a panel of domain experts and have them critique the plan.
Extract positive/negative constraints from the user's prompt.
Narrow the documents-to-create list to the most relevant ones for the current plan.
Narrow the documents-to-find list to the most relevant ones for the current plan.
Identify team members required for project execution.
Select the ~5 highest-impact levers by rating each as critical, high, or medium.
Design the governance structure and compliance requirements for the plan.
Define governance bodies and organizational hierarchy.
Create implementation plan for the governance structure.
Establish decision-making authority and escalation pathways.
Define monitoring mechanisms and progress tracking.
Validate prior governance phases with tough questions and a high-level summary.
List documents the project needs — permits, contracts, specs, research, etc.
Classify the plan as business, personal, or other to tailor downstream prompts.
Build a risk register covering strategic, operational, financial, and location-specific risks.
Identify prerequisite relationships between WBS tasks for scheduling.
Fill information gaps with grounded assumptions about costs, timelines, and resources.
Format drafted documents into a structured markdown with roles, templates, and approval steps.
Determine where the project operates — extract or suggest physical locations.
Determine if the plan is purely digital or requires physical locations.
Brainstorm actionable levers — knobs the plan can turn to change outcomes.
Guardrail: verify brainstormed levers respect the user's constraints.
Evaluate project viability and readiness before detailed planning.
Stress-test the plan's premise through five independent lenses to kill bad ideas early.
Imagine the project has already failed — identify how and why it would happen.
Generate the project plan with goals, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria.
Score how faithfully the final plan follows the user's original prompt.
Anticipate stakeholder questions and provide clear answers from the plan.
Block prompts that cross policy, legal, or ethical red lines.
Identify external resources needed: software, APIs, datasets, services, etc.
Assemble all pipeline outputs into the final HTML and Markdown reports.
Flag unreasonable, missing, or contradictory assumptions with recommendations.
Critically review the near-final plan with targeted questions and SMART recommendations.
Review and validate the assembled team composition.
Format the selected scenario and rejected alternatives into a readable document.
Flag prompts as UNUSABLE when there is high confidence the prompt is garbage.
Evaluate trade-offs and select the best scenario with a rationale.
Guardrail: verify the chosen scenario respects the user's constraints before planning begins.
Checklist-based diagnostic: find gaps, contradictions, and unsupported claims across all stages.
Read plan_raw.json and produce plan.txt from the template.
Record the pipeline start time.
Summarize the lever exploration pipeline into a readable strategic-decisions document.
Identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats tailored to the plan's purpose.
Compile team roles, contracts, backgrounds, and equipment into one team document.
Triage levers into primary, secondary, or remove.
Guardrail: verify triaged levers still respect the user's constraints.
Guardrail: verify the selected vital levers respect the user's constraints.
Merge Level 1 and Level 2 into a unified WBS project tree.
Merge all three WBS levels into the complete project hierarchy (JSON + CSV).
